# Inquiry Publishing Stack — Vault Interface entrypoint

Current component: Vault Interface
Role: provider-neutral public metadata contract. This repository is not a private vault or private control plane.

Default full-stack adoption:
full AHICP + full PPF + Vault Interface + project-owned content.

Privacy boundary:
Vault Interface exposes only approved public metadata. Original or unpublished project source remains private by default. Continuous Web may be prepared as restricted/authenticated until explicit human public-release authorization. Public links never authorize private-state retrieval.

Agent instruction:
Reconstruct the four-component ecosystem before cross-component configuration. For an ordinary private downstream project, prefer workers-builds-native + private-project-quota-saver under the personal ChongLiuPhil account: one short human-assisted GitHub → Cloudflare bootstrap, no GitHub Actions for content-only changes, one thin configuration-PR contract gate, manual heavy GitHub workflows, and Cloudflare Workers Builds as the sole automatic main-branch Web builder. Require a second content-only push to auto-deploy without renewed authorization or a duplicate Actions production build. Public framework repositories retain full CI. For Cloudflare work, follow the Starter Project Provisioning Contract, shared operational contract, and pinned PPF provider runbooks. Provider credential plaintext must never enter Vault metadata, Git, or chat/model context. Agent-provisioned external CI and the Trusted Secret Broker remain optional advanced infrastructure; public release, paid Actions, and other reserved gates still require separate human authorization.

Public delivery migration:
The four public framework sections now use one verified Cloudflare Worker at https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/. GitHub remains canonical source; former GitHub Pages sites have been retired.
Migration guide: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_DELIVERY_MIGRATION.md
Migration state: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/templates/cloudflare-public-delivery.yaml
